request: A conditionally complete lattice supremum is bounded above by c if every member of the nonempty set is at most c.

items.name: csSup_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, s.Nonempty → (∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a) → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: csSup_le_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α},
  BddAbove s → s.Nonempty → (sSup s ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a)

items.name: ciSup_le_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_4} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  BddAbove (Set.range f) → (iSup f ≤ a ↔ ∀ (i : ι), f i ≤ a)

items.name: ConditionallyCompleteLattice.csSup_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_5} [self : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (s : Set α) (a : α),
  s.Nonempty → a ∈ upperBounds s → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: le_csSup
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, BddAbove s → a ∈ s → a ≤ sSup s

items.name: ciSup_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_4} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → α} {c : α},
  (∀ (x : ι), f x ≤ c) → iSup f ≤ c
